r.name: Grey Trail, Dunwich Heath
r.description: Mixed terrain, with some uneven slopes and exposed tree roots. Please wear appropriate footwear for the terrain. Dogs on leads March 1st to August 31st.

r.name: Orange Trail, Dunwich Heath
r.description: The longest trail with heathland, woodland and grassland, filled with nature. Mixed terrain, with some uneven slopes and exposed tree roots. Please wear appropriate footwear. Dogs on leads March 1st to August 31st.

r.name: Pink Trail, Dunwich Heath
r.description: Trail has the best views of the heath, and best chance of spotting our main bird species here. The site has mixed terrain, with some uneven slopes and exposed tree roots. Please wear appropriate footwear. Dogs on leads March 1st to August 31st.

r.name: Woof Walk, Dunwich Heath
r.description: Dunwich Heath's specific dogs off leads trail! There are poo bins at the start, 1/3 and 2/3 of the way round. The site has mixed terrain, with some uneven slopes and exposed tree roots. Please wear appropriate footwear for the terrain.

r.name: Wartime Trail, Dunwich Heath
r.description: Explore the former military training area and Britain's east coast defences during World War Two. Mostly flat with some gentle slopes. Site has mixed terrain, with some uneven slopes and exposed tree roots. Please wear appropriate footwear.

r.name: Accessible Route, Dunwich Heath
r.description: Caution there may be natural trip hazards along paths such as tree roots, vegetation and debris. Follow the white arrows on green squares at path junctions, can be followed either direction.
